text:
The normal DaTscan effectively rules out Lewy body dementia and Parkinson's disease. Given the classic presentation of behavioral variant Frontotemporal Dementia (bvFTD) with disinhibition, hyperorality, and apathy, despite the non-diagnostic structural and functional tests so far, the clinical picture is highly specific.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Behavioral Variant Frontotemporal Dementia
